gloss: What sits in the context or in the researcher's mind is what the instrument then finds
invariants: Belief in context biases what is retrieved and reported
No intent to mislead is required
mechanism: {{tuning}} in a human researcher has a counterpart in models: a belief present in the context leads the model to support it, the same mechanism as {{pink_elephant}}. The cause is context, not malice. Defenses are to report every setting and to keep contested beliefs out of the context when neutral evidence is wanted.
